Our Firm

Agentis Capital Advisors is a leading global financial advisor with a reputation for delivering unparalleled value and advice to its clients. The firm has been the recipient of numerous industry rewards in recent years, including 2024 P3 Awards Financial Advisor of the Year. Our guiding principles and ability to generate value for clients sets us apart. Agentis acts as a sell-side and buy-side advisor on a wide variety of global transactions including renewable power, energy, digital, transportation, and public-private partnerships. Our clients include leading infrastructure funds, pension funds, contractors, and governments.

Agentis Capital Advisors is a business segment of Agentis Capital Partners, which operates a synergistic platform across four main business segments: Agentis Capital Partners (principal investments), Agentis Capital Advisors (financial advisory and asset management services), Agentis Capital Mining Partners (mining advisory), and Agentis Capital Markets (capital markets).



The Opportunity

The intern program includes a formal program of instruction in project finance, financial statement analysis, and financial modeling. Analyst interns are expected to demonstrate financial modeling capabilities through real-world applications and will be invited to work on active projects. You will be recognized and rewarded for your individual performance within a close-knit team and meritocratic culture. Upon successful completion of the internship, interns have the opportunity to be invited back to join Agentis in a full-time position.

Your Contribution

As an analyst intern, you can expect to be challenged from day one by complex, high-pressure assignments that will directly impact our clients and the firm. As a member of our advisory team, you will work closely in groups led by senior partners and will have exposure to a wide variety of transactions within a performance-based culture.

Your role will include:

 - Participating in the execution of equity and debt offerings, mergers and acquisitions, public-private partnerships, and principal investments

 - Assisting in the development of complex financial models for infrastructure transactions, including the use of macros and VBA programming

 - Assisting in the management of due diligence processes, including managing third-party advisors

 - Developing asset valuations using a variety of approaches

 - Preparing client presentations and participating in discussions

 - Assisting the senior team in the evaluation of investment opportunities and management of existing investments

 - Researching potential investment banking opportunities; providing research on target companies, sectors, industries, and geographies

 - Maintaining marketing materials for the firm, including creating pitch decks to be presented to potential clients.

 - As a member of a high-performing team working in a fast-paced environment, there will be times where you will be required to work beyond a normal workday or workweek to fulfill the responsibilities of the role.

Our Differentiators

 - Competitive compensation packages

 - Direct exposure to senior team members and industry leaders

 - Incredible opportunities for career growth including analyst track

 - Opportunities to work on projects with one of Agentis’ portfolio companies in other sectors including consulting, healthcare, fintech, and agriculture

 - Participation in Agentis’ internal training modules including a leadership development program

 - Regular team events

 - Potential to be invited back for a full-time position

Your Skills and Experience

 - An undergraduate degree in accounting, finance, commerce, business, statistics, computer science, engineering, mathematics, or other related areas

 - Entering your penultimate year of study (i.e. graduation by summer 2028)

 - Exceptional academic results (minimum cGPA of 80% or 3.7/4.0)

 - Ability to concisely communicate complex concepts and ideas verbally and in writing

 - Ability to take initiative and work independently with minimal supervision

 - Desire to assume increasing levels of responsibility and seek solutions to complex problems

 - Committed to producing accurate and thorough work product under tight deadlines

 - Ability to learn quickly and adapt in a fast-paced work environment

 - Resilient mindset in the face of adversity

 - Ability to work effectively in a team environment

Position Type

 - 4-Month Term, Full-Time (May to August)

 - Desired start date: May 3, 2027

 - Location: Vancouver or Toronto

About MACA Advisors

MACA Advisors is an investment banking advisory firm serving market leaders and institutional investors across Latin America and the Caribbean, with strong expertise in cross-border M&A and strategic capital raising. We offer senior-led execution, cross-border expertise and rigorous analysis through a lean platform built on client alignment, transparency and trust.

The program

The MACA Summer Associate program is an educational program for MBA students who want to understand how cross-border M&A advisory works in practice. It runs each year from June to mid-August – 1 June to 13 August 2027, and 1 June to 11 August 2028. It is built around a structured curriculum taught by the firm’s bankers, case work modeled on real transactions, and supervised observation of how our team runs mandates. The program is designed to complement your MBA, and we work with business schools to support academic credit where it is available.

What you will learn

 - Advanced financial modeling and valuation: comparable companies, precedent transactions, DCF and LBO, taught in weekly sessions and applied in case exercises

 - How a sell-side, buy-side or capital raise advisory process runs, from preparation to closing, and the judgments that shape it

 - How pitch materials, teasers and memos are structured, drafted and reviewed

 - How senior bankers prepare for and run client and counterparty meetings

 - Latin American M&A specifics, including country risk premia, FX considerations and how multiples compare with US and European benchmarks

How the program works

 - A weekly training curriculum led by the firm’s bankers

 - Case projects built on anonymized or past transactions, with written feedback on each

 - Observation of team meetings and selected client calls, followed by debrief sessions on what was decided and why

 - A designated mentor who reviews your work and meets with you each week

 - A final case presentation to the firm’s partners, with a written evaluation at the close of the program

What you bring

 - Current enrollment in an MBA or equivalent graduate business or finance program, with expected graduation in 2028 (2027 program) or 2029 (2028 program)

 - Typically two to six years of work experience before your MBA

 - Strong quantitative and financial modeling skills, and a solid grasp of accounting and valuation

 - Clear, concise written and spoken communication

 - Judgment, care in the details and a willingness to ask questions

 - Fluency in Spanish and English (Portuguese required for Brazil-based participants)

 - Based in a time zone between UTC-3 and UTC-6

Preferred

 - Pre-MBA experience in investment banking, private equity, transaction services, corporate development, consulting or credit – career switchers with strong analytical skills are welcome

 - Familiarity with Latin American and Caribbean markets

 - Curiosity about how businesses in different sectors create value, whatever your pre-MBA industry – we are a generalist firm

What you take away

 - Practical training in modeling, valuation and transaction process at a senior level

 - A body of case work you can discuss with confidence

 - A mentor relationship with a working M&A banker and direct exposure to the firm’s partners

 - A written evaluation and, on request, a reference

 - Participation in the program does not guarantee an offer of employment. Participants who complete it may apply for a full-time role: those who receive offers join as Associate following their MBA graduation, with promotion to Associate Director on 1 January following their start.

Our process

 - An interview with a partner covering your career before and during your MBA

 - A case exercise with a member of our deal team

 - Two reference calls, including one with a manager from before your MBA

 - Confirmation with your business school of any academic credit or internship agreement

About LionTree : 
 LionTree is a differentiated global investment and merchant banking firm focused on companies in the technology, media, telecom and consumer-related industries. LionTree was founded in 2012 and has offices in New York, San Francisco, and London to serve a global client base. LionTree has built a successful track record by leveraging its unique insights and relationships to assist clients across its integrated product set: Investment Banking Advisory, Public Markets / IPO Advisory and Merchant Banking Investments. 
 Since our formation, LionTree has advised on over $850bn of deal volume across over 300+ transactions. LionTree represents clients ranging from large-cap leaders to emerging growth companies. Select notable transactions include: advising Naver on its $1.2bn acquisition of Poshmark, Take-Two Interactive on its $12.7bn acquisition of Zynga, The Athletic on its sale to the New York Times, MGM Studios on its $8.5bn sale to Amazon, WarnerMedia (AT&T) and Discovery’s ~$140bn merger, Viacom on its $47bn merger with CBS, Pandora on its $3.5bn sale to SiriusXM, and Charter on its $78.7bn acquisition of Time Warner Cable. 
 Program Description: 
 LionTree offers a 11-week summer analyst program for rising seniors. As a summer analyst, you will be fully immersed in the day-to-day activities of our New York office. The program is designed to provide a realistic view of our full-time Investment Banking Analyst Program. Upon completion of the program, Summer Analysts have the opportunity to receive full-time Analyst offers for a post-graduation start date.
 As a summer analyst, you will: 
 Obtain a strong foundation in financial analysis through training from LionTree professionals as well as third-party providers
 Have the opportunity to work on live client assignments alongside LionTree deal teams
 Present financial and strategic analysis to the firm’s leadership during your final project
 Attend orientation and firm events where you will learn about LionTree and the industry while meeting members of the firm globally
 Gain access to an invaluable peer network of interns, as well as senior firm leaders and other peers through an assigned mentorship team
